Day 27 – Iran‑Israel campaign (last 2 hrs)

  • Pause & diplomacy: US announced a 10‑day second pause on Iran energy strikes until Apr 6, 2026 8:00 PM ET, citing an "Iranian Government request"; Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan is mediating. First pause was violated earlier.
  • Air operations & movements: FlightScan snapshots show 717 then 803 aircraft in region. Three military aircraft tracked: RCH864, RCH287 and a C‑130. Pattern consistent with tanker/transport support for sustained operations.
  • Lebanon / Northern border: Israel‑Lebanon talks extended one day as withdrawal deal remains elusive. TASS reports a possible memorandum of intent on security. Northern front remains active daily.
  • Hormuz & economics: Reports say Iran seeks a multibillion‑dollar role in Strait of Hormuz reopening while allowing passage for selected friendly navies and blocking others.
  • Iran leadership & defenses: Report on Khamenei’s secret bunker with blast‑resistant room and escape tunnels. Confirms regime contingency measures.
  • Allied politics: Trump reportedly criticized NATO participation in the war during a call with Dutch PM Mark Rutte. Burden‑sharing tensions increasing.
  • Domestic notes: Sa'ar to bring Armenian Genocide recognition to vote. Cultural auction news (minor).
  • 🟢 Good News: Talks extended and a formal pause announced. If upheld, these reduce immediate risk to energy infrastructure.

Situation Report — Day 27

Active strikes: Israeli strikes in Lebanon; vessel struck in the Strait of Hormuz; US/Israeli strikes on Iran continue.
  • Pause & talks: Trump announced a 10‑day pause on Iran energy strikes (deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET). He cites an Iranian request and “talks going very well.” Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan is mediating.
  • Deconfliction: Report that an Iraq/Doha deconfliction cell has IRGC and CENTCOM reps co‑located. Tactical: reduces accidental escalation if maintained.
  • Northern Border (Lebanon/Hezbollah): Daily Hezbollah activity. Israel‑Lebanon talks extended another day; possible memorandum of intent under discussion but IDF withdrawal unresolved. Quds Force commander demands Israeli pullback. Netanyahu: forces will “remain” in Lebanon, Syria, Gaza.
  • Strait of Hormuz / Maritime: UN paused a ship evacuation initiative after a vessel was struck in an Iranian attack. Iran allows passage for friendly states; crude throughput at Hormuz is highest since the war began.
  • Air & military activity: Elevated military flight activity recorded (RCH864, RCH287, RCH5036, C130). Some regional airports listed closed (Syria).
  • Domestic / Political: IDF chief says military needs every male and female combat soldier. Reports of strain in Netanyahu‑Trump alliance.
  • 🟢 Good News: Doha deconfliction cell reportedly active. Hormuz shipments rebounding. Israel‑Lebanon talks continue (extended).
Threat assessment: Escalating

48.en:
Situation Report — Day 27

  • Active: Ongoing US/Israeli airstrikes on Iranian targets. Iranian, Hezbollah and Hamas missile/drone strikes continue against Israel (daily exchanges).
  • Ceasefire/talks: Trump announced a SECOND pause on Iran-targeted energy strikes: 10 days (deadline Apr 6, 2026, 8 PM ET). US says talks progressing. Iran denies direct talks. First 5-day pause was violated within hours when US/Israeli jets struck Isfahan and Khorramshahr.
  • Diplomacy / Mediation: Pakistan mediating between sides. UN deconfliction cell in Doha reportedly hosts IRGC and CENTCOM reps — reduces accidental escalation risk.
  • Northern Border (Lebanon): Hezbollah strikes and IDF responses continue daily. Israel-Lebanon talks extended; no IDF withdrawal deal. Quds Force publicly demands Israeli pullback from Lebanon.
  • Strait of Hormuz: Iran reopened passage selectively to friendly states (Russia, India, China); blocks others. UN evacuation initiative paused after a vessel was struck. Iran says it won’t guarantee ships outside established routes. Crude shipments through Hormuz at highest level since war began.
  • Military posture: US/Israeli air campaign persists. Israel signals long-term presence in Lebanon, Syria, Gaza. IDF chief calls for mobilization of all combat-ready males and females.
  • Regime resilience: Reports detail Khamenei’s fortified bunker and escape tunnels — indicates continuity planning by Iranian leadership.
  • Good News: Deconfliction channel active in Doha. Hormuz throughput recovering. Pakistan mediation ongoing; pause announced may limit near-term energy-target strikes.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating — high tempo strikes and daily northern-front exchanges risk wider spillover.
